Beginning of Wave 5 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Molten Mode|Molten]])}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|A new enemy incoming!|Beginning of Wave 3 ([[Pre-MEGA Modes|Pre-MEGA]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Speedy''' is a fast [[Enemies|enemy]] that appears in [[Easy Mode|Easy]], [[Casual Mode|Casual]], [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]] and [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] modes. It can appear in Basic Arena and Molten Arena [[PVP]], but only if sent by a player. It also appears in the tutorial and first chapters of [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. The '''Speedy''' is faster than every enemy that appears early on. The '''Speedy''' also has a chance to be spawned by the [[Mystery]] upon its death in the [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]] mode. The [[Grave Digger]] used to have a chance to spawn the '''Speedy''' with its ''Triumphing Sheol'' ability on [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode. The '''Speedy''' was also formerly spawned by the [[Necromancer (Legacy Enemy)|Necromancer]] before its replacement. The '''Speedy''' also appeared in [[The Heights]] as part of the [[SFOTH Event]], in [[Cyber City]] as part of the [[Metaverse Champions Event]], was part of the [[The Classic Event]] and appeared in [[The Takeover Event]]. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Modern |{{Tabber |Current |The current version of the '''Speedy''' is a humanoid with a light blue skin color, with the edges of its arms being a lighter color, as well as a brown torso and legs. It is faceless and lightly covered in dirt. It has two animations that are randomly chosen. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''Speedy''' had a light blue skin color, as well as a brown torso and legs, but without a face. It originally had one animation, but after the [[V1.20.0|Intermediate Mode Update]], it had two animations that were randomly chosen. }} |Legacy |{{Tabber |Current |The current version of the '''Speedy''' has a desaturated light blue skin color, as well as a desaturated blue torso and legs. It has two diagonal scars on its face, which looks like a mirrored "y" symbol. |Current (Enemies Beta) |The current version of the [[Enemies Beta]] '''Speedy''' has a light blue skin color, as well as a brown torso and legs, but without a face. |Version 3 |The third version of the '''Speedy''' looks similar to the current one, except it has a sad face. |Version 2 |The second version of the '''Speedy''' had a light blue skin color. It had blue torso and slightly darker blue legs with a drooling zombie face. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''Speedy''' had a light blue skin color. It had a brown torso and desaturated brown legs with a drooling zombie face. }} }} ==Strategy== *Most towers can deal with the '''Speedy''' effectively. **Any tower catered towards early game, like the [[Soldier]], [[Assassin]], [[Golden Scout]], [[Militant]] or [[Cowboy]] is recommended. **It is unnecessary to try to get stronger, more expensive towers like the [[Minigunner]] solely to deal with '''Speedies''', as cheaper options fare well against them already. **Towers with high damage, but slow firerate, like the [[Sniper]], may struggle against hordes of '''Speedies''', though groups of them can handle them fairly well. **Towers that can deal damage to multiple enemies are especially effective against '''Speedies''' as they spawn in hordes. Such towers include the [[Demoman]], [[Electroshocker]], [[Pyromancer]] and [[Shotgunner]]. *It is perfectly fine to avoid defending against the first few waves of '''Speedies''' and simply let them reach the exit, as their low health makes it unlikely to make you lose. **You can use the [[Medic]] to heal the base health back, but it is not necessary. **Because you allow the '''Speedy''' to reach the base, you can use extra cash on [[Farm]]s instead of defense. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants (Modern)}} SpeedyRandomAnim.png|First version, first animation, first
